احتميتما (form VIII)
# اِحْتَمَيْتُمَا (iḥtamaytumā) /iħ.ta.maj.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of اِحْتَمَى (iḥtamā)
# اُحْتُمِيتُمَا (uḥtumītumā) /uħ.tu.miː.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of اِحْتَمَى (iḥtamā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
